title: QC defect type -> action family (v2)
description: S39 repair routing input. The closed `type` set decides which actions a defect family MAY use; the check registry decides which action a specific check starts at, over what window, and when it escalates. Changing a family is a contracts change (everything redeploys). Adding a check is a registry change (S39 does not redeploy).

forbidden.why: the container is fine; re-ingesting cannot fix a mix or loudness problem

action_preconditions.requires: window_scope in [frame, window] and window frame count <= 6
action_preconditions.why: a continuous window cannot be repaired by editing isolated frames

forbidden.when: window is continuous over more than 6 frames
forbidden.why: per-frame edits leave the motion path inconsistent
anatomy defects span many frames; per-frame repaint produces visible seams

forbidden.when: the proposed spec change alters character design
forbidden.why: character design is a human decision; a repair action may not silently rewrite canon

forbidden.when: the proposed spec change alters character design
the conflict is a cross-episode canon fact
forbidden.why: cross-episode facts belong to S16 canon; a repair action cannot redefine them
a subtitle defect never requires re-generating the video; the pixels are correct
re-translation is a paid S26 job whose output needs human acceptance; it is not an automatic repair
if the audio itself is wrong it is a `voice` defect and must be reported as one; inferring TTS redo from a lipsync defect is a cross-family reach

forbidden.when: the voice licence is expired or revoked
forbidden.why: licence state is not repairable by re-synthesis; it escalates to human review
a mix problem is not a container problem

routing.escalation: walk the family chain outward from start_point while escalation_rule is satisfied and capability is reachable
routing.human_review_not_in_chains: human_review is the shared terminal state of every family, never a chain member. Putting it in a chain would conflate 'no automatic action is reachable' with 'a human was deliberately chosen'.

invariants: Every action named in any chain, fallback, or forbidden entry MUST exist in action_enum.
Every key of families MUST exist in closed_type_set, and every member of closed_type_set MUST have a family.
fallback MUST be human_review or a chain member.
human_review MUST NOT appear in any chain.
registry entries MUST NOT name an action outside families[defect_type].chain ∪ {fallback}. The qc-sdk validator enforces this at load time; a violating registry is rejected, not logged.
why_load_time: The registry is data and will drift. A rule that only exists in prose gets violated the first time someone adds a check under deadline. Load-time rejection is the only version of this constraint that survives contact with a real team.

ownership.this_file: S35 (technical QC) authors it; contracts owns it
ownership.changed_by: adding or reordering an action in a family = contracts change = every QC service and S39 redeploy
ownership.not_changed_by: adding a check_id, changing a check's default action, changing its window or escalation = registry change = S39 untouched
